title: No more fruit flys!
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 5, 2026
review: This absolutely works! Quality of material is durable. Just insert the sticky part facing towards the wall, plug it in to outlet and your set. They swivel to accommodate sideways too. Vertical plugs, put in Bug MD at the top and you have room for another appliance plug on the bottom  Order lots of refills though, for first month, you have to catch the ones hatched from the eggs. Easy to put together, light is nice shade of blue and acts as dim night light for small areas. I had to use brighter night light in addition,  for living area, to be safe. It definitely is effective in attracting the little buggers. If they made the insert double sided with plain sticky on one side for sticking inside garbage cans, I would buy those too. I have one kit in kitchen, one in bathroom and one in living area.
